title: Two short explainers: how trip profit is calculated, and how each cost line works
summary: A two-page explainer (freight → running cost → gross margin → net profit, with flowcharts and a 1,000 km worked example) and a three-page companion on each cost line: fuel, DEF, tyres, service by age, oils, driver wage, tolls and fixed costs.
see: Shared as PDFs: Trip Profit Explained and Cost Lines Explained.

title: P&L calculation logic document and client input form
summary: A reference of every dashboard formula, the norms tables it uses and 16 business rules that need your decision, plus a fill-in-the-blanks form for your own trucks, drivers, prices and one real trip to reconcile against.
see: Shared as PDFs: Fleet P&L Calculation Logic (10 pages) and Client Input Form (6 pages). Your answers replace the default assumptions.

title: Test accounts created for demos
summary: Two shipper and two driver test accounts exist on the live app so flows can be demonstrated without real customer data.

title: Run the first real trip end-to-end on the live app
summary: No paid fleet trip has completed on the live system yet, so the P&L has never run on real data. The next step is one real load, assignment, delivery with proof, and payment, then reconciling the dashboard against your own figures.
see: Your Dashboard numbers become real instead of empty.

title: Your cost inputs replace the default assumptions
summary: Once the Client Input Form comes back, your diesel price, EMI, salaries, tyre and service figures replace the built-in norms, and any business rules you changed are implemented.
see: Dashboard and Utilisation reflect your actual costs.

title: Handwritten invoice reading
summary: OCR for handwritten invoices is deferred until the vendor and infrastructure decision is made; printed invoices already work.
see: Post a Load scan works for handwritten invoices too.
